units.source_text: 古歌：“若念亲之亲，应即来探视。

en.t: If one thinks of the parent of one's parent, one should come at once to visit.

units.source_text: 若不来探视，非我子之子。”

en.t: If one does not come to visit, then that child is not the child of my child.
This appears in the Shuishu collection.
In Japanese, the word "parent" refers to one's father or mother.

units.source_text: 亲之亲，即祖母，指前文桐壶帝戏称她为“老祖母”。

en.t: The parent of a parent means the grandmother, referring to the earlier passage where Emperor Kiritsubo jokingly called her "old grandmother."
